description: PMH-T-C120 coating cover tape is a specially formulated single-sided pressure sensitive tape. It is used for membrane end lap termination and minor membrane repair. The bottom side of the tape has a highly aggressive pressure sensitive adhesive which is designed to adhere to smooth surface pre-applied membrane.
whereToUse: This product can be used for PMH 3040/3040PLUS and PMH 6010 membranes' end lap termination and minor repair
end lap of membrane or the T-type overlapping part
notFor: It is not advisable to use the tape when temperature is lower than 5℃ as bonding strength of the tape may be affected
Make sure that the bonding surface shall be clean & dry before using the tape
The lap side must be pressed hard to ensure a good bonding effect
It is not recommended to apply tape in rainy and snowy days
Please read the MSDS carefully before application
storage: Stored in well-ventilated and dry place. Storage temperature should be below 45°C. Avoid direct sunlight, rain and high temperature. Avoid contact with acids, alkalis, oils and organic solvents.
